name: Solo Activities
entries: The person standing with feet apart and hands supporting their lower back, gently arching their upper back without bending their knees backward.
The person standing with torso facing away and head turned over one shoulder, keeping their hips aligned with their planted feet.
The person standing with one hand resting on their hip, weight over one leg and the other knee relaxed.
The person standing at a cooking surface, stirring a pan with one hand while holding its handle steady with the other.
The person seated with their back supported, holding an open book above their lap and looking down at its pages.
The person walking along a path with one foot planted and the other stepping forward, holding a folded map at their side.
The person standing with feet braced apart, extending one open hand toward a suspended fireball while keeping the other hand near their chest.
The person kneeling beside a drawn symbol, one hand hovering over its center and the other resting on their raised knee.
The person standing with both palms raised beneath several small levitating objects, leaving a visible gap between hands and objects.
Lunge: the person stepping one foot forward with the front knee bent above the ankle, rear leg extended behind and torso upright.
Cross-legged seat: the person sitting upright with shins crossed in front, hands resting on their knees and weight supported by the ground.
The person crouching on both feet beside a small object, one hand reaching toward it and the other resting on a knee for balance.
The person kneeling on one knee to fasten a bag, the opposite foot planted in front and the bag resting on the ground within reach.
The person reaching up to a shelf with one arm, feet flat on the ground and the other hand resting against the shelf's side for balance.
The person seated on a low support, leaning forward to tie one shoe with both hands while the other foot remains on the ground.
The person bending forward from the hips to inspect a surface, one palm braced beside the area being examined and the other holding a small tool.
The person stepping sideways over a low obstacle, one foot planted beyond it and the other lifted clear, with arms extended for balance.
The person standing beside a work surface, holding a small part at chest height in one hand and turning it with a tool in the other.
